metadata.title: Deploy to Testing Environments
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Deploy build artifacts to testing environments via CD/release pipeline. Loads pipeline configuration from .ai/deploy-config.json cd section, triggers the CD pipeline, monitors for completion, and handles failure with retry loop back to the parent orchestrator's Implement Work Item step.

maxDeploymentRetries.description: Maximum number of CD deployment failure -> implement fix iterations

steps.name: Trigger CD Pipeline
steps.output: CD pipeline run ID and initial status

steps.name: Evaluate Deployment Result
steps.output: Deployment decision: proceed, retry, or cap reached

flow.description: Load Config -> Trigger CD Pipeline -> Monitor Deployment -> Evaluate Result -> signal proceed/retry to orchestrator
